'''D. Claremont''' is a character who is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Claremont wrote the book ''[[The Hand That Tips The Pram]]'', which can be found in many [[Save Points in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]] throughout the game.
